verdict.rationale: The docs say Web Search returns ranked titles and URLs per result, and the Answers service is backed by verifiable sources, so basic citation data is present. Date-based freshness filtering suggests results carry dates, but no doc confirms a published-date field on each result. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a per-result published/age date field, any mention of canonical (deduplicated) URLs, a response schema or OpenAPI spec confirming these fields, and independent or hands-on corroboration of citation accuracy.
